fullPassage: Capuchins — New World Monkeys that live in large social groups — will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. I give you this rock and you give me a treat to eat. If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead — grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers — the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains — the cucumbers themselves — to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.

❌ ③ (A) 간식 — (B) 치료하다: (B)는 '치료하다'가 아니라 '대하다'
det.tip: treat: ① 간식(명사) ② 대하다(동사) (본문: a treat to eat = 먹을 간식)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the condition of being kept in a confined space and not being free"

det.analysis:

❌ ② comparison: comparison(비교)은 정의와 무관
✅ ③ captivity: captivity(사육/포획 상태)는 '갇혀 있고 자유롭지 못한 상태'라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ displeasure: displeasure(불쾌함)는 감정어라 정의와 다름

questions.passage: If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead — grapes being __________ (universal) preferred to cucumbers — the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거분사 preferred를 꾸미는 부사 자리: universal(형용사) → universally(부사)
det.analysis: 빈칸은 뒤의 'preferred(선호되는)'를 꾸미는 자리예요. 분사·형용사를 꾸미는 것은 부사이므로, 형용사 universal(보편적인)을 부사 universally(보편적으로)로 바꿔야 해요. universally preferred = 보편적으로 선호되는.
det.tip: preferred를 꾸밈 → 부사 universally (형용사 universal + -ly)

questions.passage: Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the __________ (compare) to another makes the situation unfair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 관사 the 뒤의 주어(명사) 자리: compare(동사) → comparison(명사)
det.analysis: 빈칸은 관사 the 뒤이자 동사 makes의 주어 자리예요. 이 자리에는 명사가 와야 하므로, 동사 compare(비교하다)를 명사 comparison(비교)으로 바꿔야 해요. the comparison to another = 다른 것과의 비교.
det.tip: the + 명사(주어) → comparison (동사 compare의 명사형)

questions.passage: Capuchins — New World Monkeys that live in large social groups — will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. I give you this rock and you give me a treat to eat. If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead — grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers — the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. Furthermore, she is now willing to __________ — the cucumbers themselves — to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 불쾌함을 전하려 오이(이득)마저 버린다는 맥락 → 모든 이득을 포기하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① accept every reward: '모든 보상을 받아들인다'는 항의하며 던지는 행동과 반대예요
✅ ② abandon all gains: 불쾌함을 전하려 오이 자체(이득)마저 '포기한다'는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ hide her cucumbers: '오이를 숨긴다'는 도로 던지는 행동과 어긋나요
❌ ④ ignore the experiment: '실험을 무시한다'는 본문에 근거가 없어요
det.tip: willing to abandon all gains — the cucumbers themselves
